parent_objective: design terminal-boundary source repair after M1539 audits T5 history-positive absence
blocked_by: M1538 is source-expanded positive overall but has zero T5 or terminal-boundary history-positive target sides
supersedes: direct materialization of M1538 non-terminal positives

public_gates: M1540 must design terminal-boundary source or pair repair before new implementation
M1540 must preserve the P0 actor input contract
M1540 must define T5/terminal-boundary pass and fail thresholds
M1540 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or materialize candidates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a repair route for the missing terminal-boundary history-positive evidence identified by M1539
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats M1538 non-terminal positives as terminal-boundary evidence
stop if design weakens T5 history-positive thresholds
stop if design routes directly to training or materialization
stop if design changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: route to terminal-boundary source repair implementation if design is concrete
route to task generation if existing T5 sources cannot produce accepted pairs
route to branch synthesis if terminal-boundary repair is not feasible
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1539 audit identifies T5 history-positive absence as the current blocker

admission_evidence: M1539 blocks materialization and routes to terminal-boundary repair
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: pass and fail thresholds are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1540 must design terminal-boundary tests that separate history effects from current response controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Design only for a later terminal-boundary repair run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If terminal-boundary repair cannot find history-positive rows, record that as a task-design blocker and synthesize rather than training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A targeted terminal-boundary source repair design can address the M1538 gap where T5 pairs were accepted but history-positive target sides remained zero.
success_criteria: design targets terminal-boundary source families and retarget knobs
design defines history-positive T5 pass thresholds and stop conditions
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and training-corpus export remain blocked
failure_criteria: design treats M1538 non-terminal positives as sufficient
design weakens the self-ID evidence standard
design routes directly to training promotion private holdout or materialization
decision_rule: M1540 passes if it pre-registers a terminal-boundary repair route without weakening guardrails.
